input.rationale: Section 8.2 binds Ono and its Affiliates not to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory, and fails the fallback on every prong except direction: (a) scope is class-based, catching any product whose active pharmaceutical ingredient falls within a redacted compound class, with Binimetinib and Encorafenib named only as exclusions; (b) the covenant extends past termination to an unspecified anniversary of the termination date and the in-term period is open-ended; and (c) there is no carve-out for Ono's internal development or for products or programs Ono acquires. An open-ended post-term non-compete of undefined scope is walk-away territory. Our single replacement narrows Ono's obligation (and Array's related remedies) to a product containing the named compounds Binimetinib or Encorafenib, limits it to the term with a twelve-month outer cap, and adds internal-development and acquisition carve-outs. Array's reciprocal class-wide restriction, the royalty-termination consequence and Array's Section 8.2 termination right (cross-referenced in Article XIV) are retained.

proposal.summary: Narrow Ono's Section 8.2 covenant to named compounds (Binimetinib/Encorafenib), limit it to the term with a 12-month cap, and carve out internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a class-wide, open-ended non-compete on Ono, so we have replaced the post-termination extension with language limiting Ono's Section 8.2 obligation (and Array's related remedies) to a product containing the named compounds Binimetinib or Encorafenib, confining it to the term with a twelve (12) month outer cap and carving out our internal development and acquired products or programs. Array's reciprocal restriction is untouched; this is our fallback position on non-compete restrictions.

ops.oldText: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: For purposes of Ono's obligations and Array's remedies under this Section 8.2, Competing Product means only a product, other than a Product, that includes Binimetinib or Encorafenib as an active pharmaceutical ingredient. Ono's and its Affiliates' obligations under this Section 8.2 shall apply only during the term of this Agreement and shall in no event extend beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date, and shall not restrict (i) Ono's or its Affiliates' internal research or Development activities or (ii) any product or program acquired by Ono or its Affiliates through any acquisition of or merger with a Third Party.
